messages:
Ivy Park: Heads-up, several new hires pinged me about seeing two different orientation invites with different links and times. One shows '09:00 PT' and another shows '16:00 UTC' without conversion, confusing people.
Luis Herrera: Ugh calendar dupes. I think a previous organizer created a timezone-specific repeating event and also exported an .ics which some people imported manually.
Samir Patel: Quick fix: can we consolidate to a single canonical event and attach an .ics for Outlook imports? Also include UTC in the description so folks in NZ/AU/Asia can sanity-check local times.
onboarding-bot: onboarding-bot merged events and created "New Hire Orientation - Canonical" 2026-06-01T16:00:00Z. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/5556667777 Passcode: 2046
Ivy Park: Thanks. Can someone add a line like: "Start: 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 18:00 BST / 03:00 AEST next day)" and note any DST caveats for AZ?
Luis Herrera: Done. Added .ics attachment and a short note about recording visibility: "Recordings uploaded to Drive. Internal staff: 180 days. Contractors: 30 days. For access after expiry contact legal-onboarding@redwood.com."
Samir Patel: Perfect. One more ask: if people still see the old event, please delete it and accept this invite. If it persists DM Luis and he'll resend.
Ivy Park: Recap for new hires: use the Canonical Zoom link, .ics included for Outlook, UTC shown in description, recordings to Drive with retention policy, DM Luis to fix lingering duplicate invites. Welcome! :tada:
